versions.changelog: Новая команда ask: память -> если нет, СРАЗУ интернет (Perplexity API, ключ локальный, не передаётся третьим лицам) -> ответ сохраняется в память (следующий раз из памяти). find --web — авто-фолбэк при пустом результате. Тест: 1-й ask из веба, 2-й из памяти.

Фикс 3-й итерации: кэш verify теперь версионирован (CACHE_VERSION в ключе) — устаревшие NOT FOUND из старых версий больше не подмешиваются; старый кэш на тестовой машине удалён. Проверено: verify 2/2 CONFIRMED на L2-данных из разных узлов

Перетест Краба: фикс 1 — find-фильтр шума теперь с учётом L2 (расшифровка) + стоп-слова (адрес/телефон) + требование >=2 значимых слов; фикс 2 — verify читает ЗАШИФРОВАННЫЕ L2-узлы (crypto передаётся в verify) — факты из разных узлов подтверждаются; тесты ТЗ на L2-данных: find чистый, verify 2/2 CONFIRMED

ТЗ Краба 29.08 (3 фикса): 1) find — пост-фильтр шума (только узлы с лексическим совпадением, мусор-даты отсекаются); 2) verify — агрегация фактов из РАЗНЫХ узлов + защита десятичной запятой (4,4) + учёт отрицаний (не/нет/закрыт → противоречие, не подтверждение); 3) memory.web — стабильный резолв (env → рядом со скриптом → CWD) + предупреждение вместо тихой пустой базы

CLI polish for skill-certification: --help/-h works on any Python (usage+exit 0, before the 3.11 core guard); version-guard messages prefixed with 'Error:'; doc versions synchronized (static check now PASS); SkillQA grade B 83 (honest ceiling: sandbox warn = license scripts, compat warn = Python 3.11 requirement)

SkillSpector round-3 fixes: Guardian moved out of SKILL.md into optional add-on (separate product, user-approved targets only); resume consent aligned everywhere (ask user first, no silent reload); hosted proxy prominent opt-in warning in config block; exposed_secret_literal fixed (sk-...-key -> <your-api-key>)

SkillSpector round-2 fixes: EULA 8.1/8.2 consistent (no user content leaves machine; activation sends only hashed device id; hosted modes opt-in); resume asks user first (no silent context reload); delete thread.web warns to backup first; hosted proxy warning (opt-in trust boundary, self-hosted for confidential work); secrets stored AES-256-GCM ciphertext; Guardian marked optional/outside core scope

SkillSpector fixes: INSTALL.md first-run consent-first (no auto-enable, each module defaults OFF, matches SKILL.md); Guardian scope disclosed (runs only on user-approved targets, .env masked/never logged, non-destructive probes)
v2.0.4: Verify (anti-hallucination), Guardian integrity checks, cleaner package
Live Handoff: agent resumes exactly where it stopped after /new, crash or restart. New: save-state, resume (--json), version.

- Removed the documentation file skill-card.md.
- No functional or code changes; this release only affects documentation.
- All core features and usage remain unchanged.

vibo-memory 1.0.13

- Added a new requirement for explicit user consent before enabling any ViBo modules on first run.
- Updated the setup flow: the agent now asks a single consent question covering all storage/memory modules.
- Clarified privacy practices and detailed the Privacy Layer proxy modes for local vs. hosted operation.
- Removed the `skill-card.md` file.
- SKILL.md updated for improved consent handling and privacy explanations.

vibo-memory 1.0.12

- Added new fifth product: 🛡️ Privacy Layer (ViBo Proxy) — encrypts secrets and masks them before prompts reach any LLM.
- Updated first-run activation: all modules enable automatically; proxy setup is streamlined (Docker detected, ask once; otherwise, skip).
- Specified Python 3.11 as a requirement (with compiled modules included).
- Improved onboarding and module management instructions for users ("turn off X" and re-enable guidance).
- INSTALL.md, SKILL.md updated for clarity; skill-card.md removed.
1.0.11: privacy & consent docs (retention + deletion: vibo forget/wipe), license tied to client file (survives container rebuilds), trial requires email, cleaner find output (no GPU warning).
v1.0.10: Living Archive (Product 4) + L3 secret vault (vibo setup/reveal) + fixed email trial activation
Bundle EULA; remove built-in free keys; faster semantic search (HNSW index)

vibo-memory 1.0.7

- Added new "Living Archive" product: pack documents into .vibo files (up to 9× smaller), search by meaning, answer questions in milliseconds.
- Updated documentation (SKILL.md, INSTALL.md) to describe the new archive features and trial activation via email.
- Clarified activation process: added instructions for free 2-day trial keys.
- Improved product descriptions: now lists four products (Memory, Web Search Savings, Thread Memory, Living Archive).
- Removed obsolete file: skill-card.md.

**Living Archive added: vibo-memory now packs, searches, and answers from compressed archives.**

- Introduced "Living Archive" (Product 4): pack documents into compact .vibo files (up to 9× smaller), search by meaning, and get instant answers.
- Updated activation: added free 2-day trial by email in addition to paid key.
- SKILL.md and INSTALL.md updated for new features, commands, and documentation.
- Removed deprecated skill-card.md file.

vibo-memory 1.0.5

- Updated SKILL.md title/intro for clarity (removed "living archive" from main heading)
- Extended and clarified product descriptions in SKILL.md; overall wording streamlined
- Minor structural changes and formatting improvements in documentation
- No functional or code changes; documentation only

vibo-memory 1.0.4

- Major SKILL.md rewrite: streamlined and condensed documentation, improved readability, and reorganized sections.
- Removed Python code samples; now focuses on CLI usage and key conceptual explanations.
- Updated product descriptions, agent rules, and emphasized token savings messaging.
- Skill structure and installation guidance clarified; see INSTALL.md for further integration.
